ann.t: General Updates — The Board of Directors of GFL Limited took note of the order Pronounced by Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) through Circular Resolution. The Board further approved the filing Form INC-28.

Scheme of Arrangement — We wish to inform you that on Thursday, October 15, 2026 the Company has received the Certified true copy of the final order pronounced by Hon'ble Tribunal (NCLT) after its hearing held on Monday 28 September, 2026. The appointed date of the Scheme is April 01, 2026.
